description: Source-reported circulating supply, separate from total supply and FDV.

description: Source-reported fully diluted valuation. It is not substituted for circulating market capitalization.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Buy volume
description: Aggregate buy-side volume over the explicitly declared window.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Sell volume
description: Aggregate sell-side volume over the explicitly declared window.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Unique buyers
description: Distinct buying addresses within the declared source window; not an independently identified person count.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Unique sellers
description: Distinct selling addresses within the declared source window; not an independently identified person count.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Quote reserve
description: Pool quote-asset reserve. The adapter must bind the quote asset; this value is not automatically USD.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Base reserve
description: Pool base-token reserve from the source capture; no executable depth guarantee is implied.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Quoted price impact
description: Source-reported nonnegative price-impact magnitude in basis points for a separately archived quote, size and route.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Largest holder share
description: Share attributed to the largest holder under the source denominator and exclusion rules.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Source-tagged insider share
description: Holder share tagged as insider-related by the source; the label is not independent attribution.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Holder count change
description: Signed change in an aggregate holder count across the declared window, not identified joins or exits.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Creator token balance
description: Token balance attributed to the creator address by the source.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Mint authority
description: Source-reported Solana mint authority address. An absent authority must be expressed through an explicit source flag, not an invented address.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Freeze authority
description: Source-reported Solana freeze authority address. Syntactic validity does not establish current authority.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Transfers paused
description: Source-reported transfer-pause state; false is not a general transferability guarantee.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Sell simulation succeeded
description: Result reported for a separately archived sell simulation. It does not prove a real fill or future sellability.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: EVM block number
description: Source observation block number, without an implied finality or canonical-chain guarantee.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: Solana slot
description: Source observation slot, without an implied finality guarantee.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.

label: X follower count
description: Source-reported follower count for the associated profile; association is not verified affiliation.
note: Optional adapter input. Catalog support does not mean this field is collected or independently verified.
